title: Hui Zhidao
summary: An AI talent-policy self-check and application-preparation assistant for Xuhui, built from concept to working prototype in about 3-4 hours.
summaryZh: 面向徐汇区人才政策场景的智能自查与申报准备助手，在约 3-4 小时内完成从概念到可交互原型。
intro: Hui Zhidao turns scattered policy information into a guided decision flow. Users can upload a resume, complete missing profile details through AI clarification, compare eligibility across policies, identify gaps and materials, and generate an actionable preparation report.
introZh: “汇知道”将分散的人才政策信息转化为连续、可执行的决策流程。用户可以上传简历，通过 AI 追问补全个人画像，匹配适用政策，识别条件差距与材料清单，并生成可行动的申报准备报告。

contentSections.title: Context
contentSections.content: The prototype was created during a Xuhui District AI entrepreneurship activity. The core challenge was turning dense, scattered policy documents into a clear personal decision path.
contentSections.contentZh: 该原型完成于一次徐汇区 AI 创业相关活动。项目关注的核心并不是政策信息缺失，而是如何把密集、分散的政策文件转化为清晰的个人判断路径。

contentSections.title: Product Flow
contentSections.content: Resume upload, AI profile extraction, clarification of missing information, policy matching, gap and material analysis, then an actionable report.
contentSections.contentZh: 上传简历，AI 解析个人画像，追问缺失信息，匹配政策，分析条件差距与材料清单，最终生成可执行的准备报告。

contentSections.title: Rapid Build
contentSections.content: Built in about 3-4 hours, the prototype prioritizes a complete demonstrable loop across applicant self-check, service guidance and administrative review.
contentSections.contentZh: 项目在约 3-4 小时内快速完成，优先建立从人才自查、服务引导到管理端查看的完整可演示闭环。

contentSections.title: Prototype Note
contentSections.content: This is an independent product prototype. Matching results and generated reports are for demonstration only and do not replace official policy interpretation or review.
contentSections.contentZh: 这是一个独立产品原型。匹配结果与生成报告仅用于演示，不替代官方政策解释与审核结论。

title: AI Customer Service Platform
titleZh: AI 客服智能体运营平台
summary: An operations platform for AI customer-service agents, combining agent management, knowledge assets, analytics and workflow governance.
summaryZh: 面向 AI 客服智能体的运营平台，整合智能体管理、知识资产、数据分析与流程治理。
intro: A dashboard-style workspace for operating AI customer-service agents, with modules for agent management, knowledge assets, visitor interactions, analytics and governance.
introZh: 一个面向 AI 客服智能体运营的工作台式平台，包含智能体管理、知识资产、访客互动、数据分析与平台治理等模块。

contentSections.title: Overview
contentSections.content: The project focuses on the operational side of AI customer service. Rather than presenting a single chatbot, it organizes the workspace around agent performance, knowledge management, visitor interactions and platform governance.
contentSections.contentZh: 项目关注 AI 客服的运营侧，而非单个聊天机器人本身。整个产品围绕智能体绩效、知识管理、访客互动与平台治理组织工作空间。

contentSections.title: Information System
contentSections.content: The interface brings agent matrices, satisfaction, resolution rate, escalation rate, unknown-question rate, risk sessions and operational actions into one structured overview.
contentSections.contentZh: 界面将智能体矩阵、满意度、解决率、转人工率、未知问题率、风险会话与运营动作整合在同一个结构化概览中。

contentSections.title: Interaction
contentSections.content: A persistent intelligent operations assistant occupies the right side of the workspace, allowing operational tasks to be initiated without leaving the current analytical context.
contentSections.contentZh: 智能运营助手常驻工作区右侧，使用户无需离开当前分析语境，即可发起知识库、报告与机器人配置等任务。

title: Webcoding Trash
summary: A playful sharing and remix platform for small AI-coding experiments, unfinished prototypes and strange-but-interesting web ideas.
summaryZh: 面向 AI Coding 时代的轻量作品分享与二创平台，让简单、未完成但有趣的网页作品被看见、被体验、被再次改造。
intro: Webcoding Trash is a low-pressure creative playground for the AI Coding era. Instead of asking every work to become a polished product, it gives small ideas, half-finished pages and strange experiments a place to be discovered, played with and continued by someone else.
introZh: “垃完了”是一个面向 AI Coding 时代的低压力创作游乐场。它不要求每个作品都成为完成度很高的产品，而是让一个突然冒出的点子、一个半成品网页或一个奇怪的小实验，都有机会被发现、被体验，并被下一个人继续改造。

contentSections.title: Context
contentSections.content: AI coding tools have made it possible to turn natural-language ideas into interactive pages in minutes. At the same time, many of these works are too experimental for a formal portfolio and too lightweight for a traditional developer community, so they disappear before anyone can respond to them.
contentSections.contentZh: AI Coding 工具让自然语言想法可以在几分钟内变成可交互网页，但大量作品又太实验性，不适合放进正式作品集，也太轻量，难以进入传统开发者社区，常常还没有被回应就消失了。

contentSections.title: Product Positioning
contentSections.content: The product combines AI-coding sharing with lightweight remixing. It is designed for Vibe Coding beginners, hackathon teams, creative developers and anyone who wants to make something playful without first proving that it is useful or complete.
contentSections.contentZh: 项目定位为“AI Coding 分享 + 轻二创平台”，面向 Vibe Coding 初学者、黑客松团队、创意网页制作者，以及想先做出点好玩东西、而不是先证明它足够实用和完整的人。

contentSections.title: Core Loop
contentSections.content: The experience follows a simple loop: discover, experience, modify and rediscover. A random inspection deck makes browsing feel like digging through a playful archive; interactive previews let people use the work instead of only looking at a screenshot; the recycle queue turns a viewer into the next creator.
contentSections.contentZh: 产品围绕“被看见 → 被体验 → 被改变 → 再次被看见”展开。随机质检牌组像翻找一个有趣的数字档案库，互动预览让用户真正操作作品，而不是只看截图；回收区则让浏览者成为下一位创作者。

contentSections.title: Feature System
contentSections.content: The inspection area supports random draws, card flipping, live sandbox interaction, favorites and tags. The recycle area collects selected works and offers preset remix directions or natural-language instructions before publishing a mutant version back into the pool. The personal space records inspection progress, saved works, pending remixes and creation history.
contentSections.contentZh: “垃圾质检”支持随机抽取、翻开卡牌、进入沙盒体验、收藏和贴标签；“回收再造”收集感兴趣的作品，通过预置改造方向或自然语言指令完成二创，再把变异版本发布回作品池；“我的空间”则记录抽检进度、收藏、待回收项目和创作历史。

contentSections.title: Hackathon Team
contentSections.content: Created for the final roadshow by team 夯爆了: Zhang Yuguang, Wang Meng and Zhang Bohan. The visual language uses a dark mobile container, acid-lime action color and playful trash/recycle metaphors to make experimentation feel casual rather than intimidating.
contentSections.contentZh: 项目用于决赛路演，由“夯爆了”团队完成：张裕广、王萌、章博涵。视觉上采用深色移动端容器、酸性荧光绿操作色和“垃圾 / 回收”隐喻，让实验和试错变得轻松，而不是有压力的作品提交。
